# Handsome Photobooth

> Open-air DSLR photo booth rental for weddings, corporate events, and parties across the San Francisco Bay Area, with locations in Alameda and San Leandro, California.

- 3-Hour Glam Package: $899. Includes three operating hours, DSLR photos, studio lighting, a modern backdrop, unlimited 2x6 strip or 4x6 instant prints, a custom print template, 70+ props, an on-site attendant, QR downloads, a Google Photos digital album, and setup and breakdown.
- Add-ons: additional hour $150; photo album with all pictures $49; scrapbook service $99.
- Booking: send date, venue, and guest count; a 50% deposit with a signed agreement secures the date; the balance is due 30 days before the event. Travel fees outside the standard Bay Area service area are confirmed in the quote.
- Space and power: about 10 ft x 10 ft for the booth, backdrop, and prop table, plus room for a line; one standard power outlet.
- Areas served: San Francisco, Oakland, Berkeley, Alameda, San Leandro, Hayward, Fremont, Pleasanton, San Jose, Santa Clara, Sunnyvale, San Mateo, Daly City, and the wider Bay Area.
- Locations: 1209 Park St, Alameda, CA 94501; 1415 E 14th St, San Leandro, CA 94578.
- Contact: leo@handsomephotobooth.com or the inquiry form at https://handsomephotobooth.com/#contact
